description: Create or update a Linear issue label. If `id` is provided, updates the existing label; otherwise creates a new one. When creating, `name` is required.

description.description: Label description. Null to clear it

groupType.description: Selection mode for label groups. Defaults to singleSelect when creating; omit to keep it unchanged when updating

id.description: Label name or ID. If provided, updates the existing label

isGroup.description: Whether the label is a group

parent.description: Parent label group name or ID. Null to remove from its group

teamId.description: Team UUID (omit for workspace label). When updating, only disambiguates `id` by name; a label's team cannot be changed

name: save_issue_label
title: Save issue label
